title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement: You are given two sorted linked lists list1 and list2. Merge the two lists into one sorted list and return its values.
hints: Create a dummy head node to simplify attaching the first element.
Compare current heads of list1 and list2, advance the smaller one.
Append any remaining elements when one list is exhausted.

solutions.title: Iterative Dummy Node Merge
Recursive Merge
solutions.complexity: Time: O(n + m) | Space: O(n + m)

editorial.approach: Two-pointer simulation: create a dummy head node. Compare the current elements of list1 and list2; attach whichever has the smaller value to the current merged tail and advance that list's pointer. Repeat until one list is exhausted, then append the remainder of the non-empty list directly.
editorial.why_optimal: Walks each element of both lists at most once in O(N + M) time and O(1) extra space (relinking existing pointers or building output array in-place).
editorial.pitfalls: Losing the head reference by advancing without a dummy node. Failing to attach remaining elements after one list runs out.
